newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunker levels stable but talk thin.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunker levels stable but talk thin.

text.p: The Singapore bunker quotes were stable on Friday but talk was thin ahead of the weekend, traders said.

Enquiries were few but suppliers said they would not lower offers to get business when cargo levels is relatively firm. "It doesn't make sense to offer the 380-cst at below $96 per tonne unless you want to take losses," said one trader.
The 380-cst was heard offered at $96/$98 per tonne and the 180-cst at $103/$105. MDO and gas oil were quoted at around $190 and $200 respectively.
